name: switchbot
description: Control SwitchBot smart-home devices from Gemini CLI via MCP using the default tool profile and policy-based safety gates

settings.name: SwitchBot Token
settings.description: Optional SwitchBot Open API token. Prefer switchbot auth login so the CLI can use its OS-keychain credentials. If you configure this value, it supplies SWITCHBOT_TOKEN for the extension.

settings.name: SwitchBot Secret
settings.description: Optional SwitchBot Open API secret. Prefer switchbot auth login so the CLI can use its OS-keychain credentials. If you configure this value, it supplies SWITCHBOT_SECRET for the extension.
